The model and adaptations retain this licence. No commercial use. Derivatives
must use the same licence and retain attribution and modification notices.
Modifications: one independent upright shell from three posed copies; uniform
physical registration; fixed Diddy Kong Racing image excluded; independent
per-game sticker surface and native texture export. Source UVs, geometry and
plastic map retained. Simple albedo lighting. See source.json and the theme's
MODEL_CREDITS.txt for exact file scope and registrations.
Independent processing code retains its own MIT licence.
